module: Powertrain component `sequentialGearbox`: sequential gearbox (racing type) whose gear can only change one step at a time (plus one, minus one). No synchronizers or grinding: the gear shift takes effect at the next per-frame update (updateGFX). Like manualGearbox, the parent must be a clutch. Handles neutral (virtual mass), locking (setLock), wear/damage and "straight-cut" type gear sounds. A sequential gearbox controller calls setGearIndex.
usage:
local gb = powertrain.getDevice("gearbox")
gb:setGearIndex(gb.gearIndex + 1) -- shift up one gear (limited to +/- 1 per call)
print(gb.gearIndex, gb.gearRatio)
notes: Jbeam keys read: name, type, inputName, inputIndex, gearRatio, friction (N·m), dynamicFriction (N·m per rad/s), torqueLossCoef (0..1), gearRatios (required list: values >= 0 = forward gears at indices 0, 1, 2…; values < 0 = reverse gears, same indexing as manualGearbox), gearWhineCoefs / gearWhineCoefsOutput / gearWhineCoefsInput, gearboxNode_nodes, breakTriggerBeam, and for the sounds: gearWhineOutputEvent ('event:>Vehicle>Transmission>straight_01>twine_out_race'), gearWhineInputEvent, forward/reverse Input/Output PitchCoef, gearWhine*Smoothing.

Main fields: gearIndex (current gear, 0 = neutral), targetGearIndex (gear waiting for the update, nil otherwise), gearRatio, gearRatios (table keyed by gearIndex), minGearIndex, maxGearIndex, maxGearRatio, minGearRatio, gearCount, inputAV (rad/s clutch side), outputAV1 (rad/s, set by the child), outputTorque1 (N·m), lockCoef (0 if locked), virtualMassAV, cumulativeInertia, cumulativeGearRatio, maxCumulativeGearRatio, isBroken, transmissionNodeID.

setGearIndex limits the jump: the requested gear is clamped to [gearIndex - 1, gearIndex + 1] (and to [minGearIndex, maxGearIndex]). From neutral (gearIndex = 0) the change is immediate; from an engaged gear, it is deferred to the next updateGFX (targetGearIndex). In neutral, as soon as a gear is entered, powertrain.calculateTreeInertia is called.
Neutral or broken gearbox (gearRatio == 0 or isBroken): velocityUpdate/torqueUpdate switch to the "neutral" versions (virtual mass, zero output torque).

Minor bug: calculateInertia computes invCumulativeInertia = 1 / cumulativeInertia without protection against a zero inertia; validate reads device.parent.parent without checking that device.parent is not nil.
setGearIndex at construction: maxExpectedInputTorque is 0, which sets invMaxExpectedOutputTorque to infinity until validate; no observable effect because the sound is only active afterwards.

new.desc: Builds the sequential gearbox: forward and reverse ratio table, gear whine coefficients, transmission node, then goes to neutral.

jbeamData.desc: jbeam data of the component (gearRatios required).

device.desc: Object returned by new(jbeamData). velocityUpdate/torqueUpdate depend on the gear (normal or neutral).

updateSounds.desc: Updates the volume and pitch of the gear sound loops (input and output) from smoothed speeds and torques. Called every frame.

velocityUpdate.desc: Called at each physics step: inputAV = outputAV1 * gearRatio * lockCoef (or virtual mass in neutral), written to the parent.

torqueUpdate.desc: Called at each physics step: outputTorque1 = (parent torque - friction) * gearRatio * lockCoef, and feeds the sound smoothers. In neutral, integrates the virtual mass and sets the output torque to 0.

dt.desc: Time step in seconds (used in neutral).

updateGFX.desc: Per-frame update: applies the pending gear change (targetGearIndex), updates gearRatio, invMaxExpectedOutputTorque and the powertrain inertia.

setGearIndex.desc: Requests a gear. The gear is clamped to ±1 step around the current gear and to [minGearIndex, maxGearIndex]. From neutral, it is applied immediately; otherwise deferred to the next updateGFX.

index.desc: Desired gear index (0 neutral, >0 forward, <0 reverse).

onBreak.desc: Marks the gearbox as broken and switches to neutral mode (virtual mass).

setLock.desc: Locks (lockCoef = 0) or unlocks (1) the transmission and propagates the call to the parent if it has setLock.

applyDeformGroupDamage.desc: Increases the damage friction coefficient (0.01 of damage = +0.1).

damageAmount.desc: Amount of damage of the deformation group.

setPartCondition.desc: Applies wear (odometer, coefficient from 1 to 2) and damage (integrity number 0..1 or table); calls onBreak if isBroken.

getPartCondition.desc: Returns the integrity 0..1 (0 if broken) and {damageFrictionCoef, isBroken}.

validate.desc: Checks that the parent is a clutch (or a fake one), otherwise logs errors and returns false. Determines transmissionNodeID and the expected values (max torque, speed, power) to normalize the sounds.

returns.desc: false if the parent is not a clutch.

calculateInertia.desc: Takes the inertia and cumulative ratios of the first child; cumulativeInertia = inertia / gearRatio² (2 * maxGearRatio in neutral).

resetSounds.desc: Resets the gear sound smoothers and values.

initSounds.desc: Creates the gear sound loops (input and output), the smoothers and the pitch coefficients, and sets the FMOD parameter c_gearboxMaxPower.

reset.desc: Resets the state (speeds, torque, coefficients, locking) and goes back to neutral.
